services.name: Carpet Cleaning
services.summary: Van-mounted hot water extraction for carpets in homes, rentals and businesses across Central Otago, Southern Lakes and the Maniototo.
services.seoTitle: Carpet Cleaning Central Otago | Advanced Carpets
services.seoDescription: Carpet cleaning and hot water extraction in Cromwell, Queenstown, Wanaka and nearby areas. Van-mounted equipment for homes and businesses. Make an enquiry.
services.intro: We clean carpets with a van-mounted hot water extraction system and industrial-grade equipment. The system supplies its own power and hot water, so we do not need to use yours.
services.overview: We clean carpets in homes, rentals, offices, pubs and other commercial spaces. Whether it is a one-time deep clean or regular maintenance, we check the carpet and its condition before choosing the treatment.

sections.heading: Hot water extraction for a deeper clean
paragraphs: Hot water extraction injects hot water at high pressure to loosen embedded dirt, oils and debris from carpet fibres. We pre-treat suitable spots and traffic lanes, then use the van-mounted machine to clean and extract the soiled water.

The heat can kill many common bacteria, mould spores and dust mites, reducing allergens. High water temperature also helps strip greasy soiling from carpets in pubs and restaurants. We adjust the treatment to the fibre, pile, level of soiling and problem areas.
bullets: The van-mounted system supplies its own power and hot water, so we do not add to your power or hot-water use.
Carpets usually take 4 to 8 hours to dry. Carpet thickness, soiling, indoor temperature, airflow and weather can change that time.
Where suitable, we can use minimal cleaning agents for households with children or pets.
High-temperature cleaning and suitable pre-treatment can lift grease and other stubborn marks, although stain removal depends on the carpet and what has already been applied.

sections.heading: How often should carpet be professionally cleaned?
paragraphs: How often you should clean carpet depends on usage, traffic and the home environment. These are the practical schedules we recommend:
bullets: Light to moderate traffic: deep clean every 12 to 18 months and vacuum weekly.
High-traffic areas or homes with children: deep clean every 12 months and vacuum 2 to 3 times a week.
Homes with pets: deep clean every 6 to 8 months and vacuum 3 to 4 times a week to manage hair and odours.
Allergy or asthma sufferers: deep clean every 6 to 8 months and vacuum weekly with a high-efficiency filter.

services.whyAdvanced: We are locally owned and operated, with 16+ years of experience in the region. Our IICRC-certified technicians use commercial equipment and explain what is realistic for the carpet before work begins.
reasons: Pet marks, odours, dust mites and allergens
Greasy or heavily used commercial carpets
included: Inspect the fibre, condition, soiling and problem areas
Pre-treat suitable spots and traffic lanes
Clean with hot water extraction using van-mounted equipment
Allow 4 to 8 hours for drying, then follow the vacuuming schedule for your household
exclusions: No stain can be guaranteed to disappear. Old marks, colour loss and previous home treatments can limit the result.

faqs.question: How long does carpet cleaning take to dry?
faqs.answer: Usually 4 to 8 hours. Carpet type, pile thickness, soiling, indoor temperature, airflow and weather can affect drying time.

faqs.question: Do you need to use my power or hot water?
faqs.answer: No. Our van-mounted carpet cleaning system supplies its own power and hot water.

faqs.question: Do I need to move furniture before you arrive?
faqs.answer: Please move small furniture off the areas we are going to clean.

faqs.question: Can you clean upholstery and carpets in the same visit?
faqs.answer: Yes, we can arrange to clean both in the same visit.

services.name: Upholstery Cleaning
services.summary: Specialised upholstery cleaning for couches, chairs, mattresses and fabric furniture in homes and businesses.
services.seoTitle: Upholstery Cleaning Central Otago | Advanced Carpets
services.seoDescription: Professional upholstery and couch cleaning in Cromwell, Queenstown, Wanaka and nearby areas. We check the fabric before cleaning. Make an enquiry.
services.intro: We clean lounge suites, mattresses, chairs and other fabric furniture with specialised upholstery tools. Our technicians check the material first and choose a method suited to its condition.
services.overview: We clean furniture for homeowners, accommodation providers, offices, landlords and property managers. The fabric, previous treatments and cause of any marks all affect what can be cleaned and how.

sections.heading: Cleaning for furniture you use every day
paragraphs: Professional upholstery cleaning every 12 to 24 months removes deep-seated dirt, allergens and bacteria that regular vacuuming cannot remove. Spills such as wine and coffee can oxidise and bond permanently with fabric dyes if they are not treated with the right professional chemistry.

Steam cleaning can bring dull-looking colours back to life. Regular cleaning also removes dead skin cells and food crumbs that dust mites and other microscopic pests feed on, effectively starving them out of your furniture.
bullets: Lounge suites, couches and armchairs
Dining chairs, office seating and accommodation furniture
Mattresses and other suitable fabric surfaces

sections.heading: Fabric checks and drying
paragraphs: Not every fabric can be wet cleaned. We inspect the material, condition and problem areas, then test and pre-treat suitable areas before using specialised upholstery tools.

A typical visit may take around 1.5 to 3 hours, depending on the size and number of items. Drying commonly takes around 4 to 8 hours and varies with the fabric and airflow. Many homes arrange upholstery cleaning every 12 to 24 months, with more frequent attention where use and spills are heavier.

services.whyAdvanced: Our IICRC-certified team checks the fabric before treatment and explains any limits, including old stains, permanent colour loss and drying time. We use equipment selected for furniture rather than treating every item like carpet.
reasons: Built-up soil on couches and chairs
Spills and marks on fabric furniture
Routine cleaning for homes, offices or accommodation
included: Inspect fabric, condition and problem areas
Test and pre-treat suitable marks
Clean suitable items with specialised upholstery tools
Allow around 4 to 8 hours for the fabric to dry
exclusions: Some fabrics cannot be wet cleaned. Cleaning cannot reverse permanent fading, colour loss or fabric damage, and old marks may remain.

faqs.answer: It usually takes around 4 to 8 hours. Fabric, construction, indoor conditions and airflow can change the time.

faqs.question: How often should upholstery be professionally cleaned?

faqs.question: Can cleaning improve faded-looking fabric?
faqs.answer: It may brighten fabric when dullness is caused by soil, but it cannot reverse permanent fading or colour loss.

services.name: Stain Treatment
services.summary: Targeted carpet stain treatment for food, drink, pet accidents, mud, grease and other difficult marks.
services.seoTitle: Carpet Stain Removal Central Otago | Advanced Carpets
services.seoDescription: Carpet stain treatment in Cromwell, Queenstown, Wanaka and Central Otago. We assess the fibre and stain before choosing a treatment. Make an enquiry.
services.heroHeading: Carpet stain removal across Central Otago, Southern Lakes and the Maniototo
services.intro: From fresh spills to old, set-in marks, we use targeted carpet stain treatments chosen for the fibre and cause of the mark. We assess the carpet before choosing a method and explain what is realistic.
services.overview: We treat carpet stains in homes and businesses, including food and drink spills, pet accidents, mud, grease and rust. The sooner we see a mark, and the fewer products applied to it, the better the chance of improvement.

sections.heading: Our approach to carpet stains
paragraphs: Every stain is different. We start by assessing the carpet fibre, the age of the stain and what caused it. We then choose a suitable treatment, which may include fibre-safe solutions, targeted spot treatment and hot water extraction.
Stubborn or set-in marks may need more than one treatment pass. Some staining, colour loss or fibre damage cannot be removed by cleaning.
bullets: Food and drink spills, including wine, coffee, juice and sauces
Pet marks, mud, grass, grease and oil
Rust, mineral marks, ink, dye and older set-in stains

sections.heading: What to do when a spill happens
paragraphs: Act promptly. Blot the area with a clean white towel instead of rubbing it. Add a little cold water and keep blotting to dilute the spill. If the mark remains, stop and contact us.
Household cleaners and carpet stain products can react with the fibres or make a mark harder to treat. Please tell us what has already been used on the area.

services.whyAdvanced: Our IICRC-certified technicians check the fibre and stain before using a product. We turn up on time, treat your home with care and do not leave until we are confident in the result.
reasons: Old stains that previous cleaning has not shifted
included: Identify the likely stain and inspect the carpet fibre
Test the treatment where needed
Apply suitable spot treatment and extraction
Check for remaining marks, colour loss or fibre damage
exclusions: No stain-removal result is guaranteed. Colour loss and fibre damage cannot be cleaned away, and past home treatments can reduce the chance of removal.

faqs.question: What should I do as soon as a spill happens?
faqs.answer: Blot it with a clean white towel rather than rubbing. Add a little cold water and keep blotting. If the mark remains, stop and contact us.

faqs.question: Should I use a household stain remover first?
faqs.answer: We recommend avoiding other products until the carpet and stain have been assessed. Some treatments can react with the fibre or make the mark harder to remove.

faqs.question: Can you treat pet stains and odours?
faqs.answer: Often, but the result depends on how large the affected area is, how often it has been soiled and how far it has reached into the carpet and underlay.

faqs.question: Can you remove an old or set-in stain?
faqs.answer: We can assess it and may use more than one treatment pass. Older marks and previous cleaning attempts can limit the result, so removal is not guaranteed.

services.name: Flood Restoration
services.summary: 24/7 response for water damage, extraction, structural drying and moisture monitoring across the full service area.
services.seoTitle: Water Damage Restoration Central Otago | Advanced Carpets
services.seoDescription: Flood restoration and water damage drying across Central Otago, Queenstown, Wanaka and the Maniototo. 24/7 emergency response. Call 021 333 354.
services.heroHeading: Water damage and flood restoration across Central Otago, Southern Lakes and the Maniototo
services.intro: When water damages a property, starting the drying process promptly can help limit further harm. We respond to flood and water damage emergencies 24/7 across our full service area.
services.overview: We help homes and businesses after burst pipes, appliance overflows, roof leaks, storms and other water damage. Water can travel further than the visible wet area, so our first step is to assess where moisture has reached.

sections.heading: Our flood restoration process
paragraphs: Every water damage situation is different. We assess the affected area and take moisture readings from carpets, floors and walls to understand how far the water has travelled. We then extract standing water and begin structural drying with industrial-grade air movers and dehumidifiers.

We continue monitoring moisture levels throughout drying to ensure the property is fully dry before we finish. The water source, time elapsed and materials affected determine what can be dried and what may need removal.
bullets: Moisture assessment beyond the visible wet area
Standing-water extraction
Air movers, dehumidifiers and ongoing moisture monitoring

sections.heading: Why acting promptly matters
paragraphs: The first 24 to 48 hours after a flood are important. Left untreated, moisture can reach subfloors, wall linings and furniture and increase the risk of mould, warping and lingering odours.
Call us as soon as it is safe. Stop the water source if you can do so safely, and avoid electrical or contaminated-water hazards.

sections.heading: Working with your insurer
paragraphs: You can choose your local restoration provider. We work with all insurance companies and can communicate with them directly about documentation and invoicing, so you can focus on your home or business while the drying work is under way.

services.whyAdvanced: Our IICRC-qualified technicians use moisture readings, extraction and drying equipment to guide the work. Emergency response is available at any hour, with a normal response range of 20 minutes to 2 hours across the full service area.
reasons: Blocked or overflowing gutters and drains
included: Assess affected areas and take moisture readings
Extract standing water
Set up air movers and dehumidifiers for structural drying
Take repeat moisture readings while affected materials dry
exclusions: Some materials cannot be saved. Electrical, structural or hazardous work may need another specialist, and drying time depends on the water source and extent of damage.

faqs.question: Should I contact you as soon as water damage occurs?
faqs.answer: Yes. Prompt assessment and drying can help reduce secondary damage. If it is safe, stop the water source and avoid electrical hazards.

faqs.question: How quickly can you respond?
faqs.answer: Our normal response range is 20 minutes to 2 hours across Central Otago, Southern Lakes and the Maniototo. Emergency response is available 24/7.

faqs.question: What should we do before you arrive?
faqs.answer: Call us, turn off the water source if safe and contact a plumber where needed. Keep clear of electrical and contaminated-water hazards.

faqs.question: Can wet carpet and underlay always be saved?
faqs.answer: No. This depends on the water source, how long the materials have been wet and their condition. We will assess them and explain the options.

faqs.question: Do I have to use the provider suggested by my insurer?
faqs.answer: You can choose your local restoration provider. We can communicate with your insurer about documentation and invoicing for the work.

services.intro: We clean hard floors in homes and businesses, including vinyl, tile and grout. Our technicians assess the surface and finish before recommending cleaning, scrubbing or polishing.
services.overview: Hard floors in busy homes, shops, offices and hospitality spaces collect grit and dirt that can wear the finish over time. We choose a treatment based on the floor type, condition and level of soiling.

sections.heading: Hard floor treatments we offer
paragraphs: Our services include scrub and buff for lighter maintenance, strip and polish for suitable floors with a dulled finish, targeted grout cleaning and sealing where appropriate. Not every floor can be polished, so we inspect the material and existing coating first.
bullets: Vinyl and lino flooring
Ceramic and porcelain tile with grout lines
Suitable natural stone and commercial hard flooring
Selected wood veneer and concrete floors after assessment

sections.heading: An approach matched to the floor
paragraphs: Grit left on hard floors acts like sandpaper underfoot. Regular cleaning removes the build-up and helps protect the surface. We assess the floor type, current finish and soiling before choosing products or equipment.

A cleaned floor may be ready to walk on straight away. If a polish is applied, allow at least 12 hours before using the floor, subject to the product and conditions. We explain this before work begins.

services.intro: From a small burn to loose or rippling carpet, we assess the damage and explain whether a repair is practical. Where possible, repairing a local area can avoid replacing the whole carpet.
services.overview: We repair carpets in homes and businesses. Burns, tears, pet damage, failing seams and loose carpet can often be assessed for patching, joining or power stretching.

sections.heading: How we assess and repair carpet
paragraphs: We start with an on-site assessment of the damage and the carpet. For a small patch, matching carpet may be taken from a spare offcut or an inconspicuous area such as a cupboard. Matching material needs to be available on site.

For loose or rippling carpet, we use professional power-stretching equipment to re-tension it and help prevent premature wear. We explain which method is realistic for the material and affected area before work starts.

Moving-furniture damage, including dents and flattened patches
Seam and carpet-to-hard-floor transition repairs
Patch repairs using available matching carpet

sections.heading: When repair makes sense
paragraphs: A damaged patch or fraying seam can get worse with foot traffic. Repairing it promptly may improve the appearance and prevent the affected area spreading. Loose carpet can also be a trip hazard.
A repair will not always be invisible. Colour, pile direction, wear and the available matching carpet affect the finish. We will tell you when replacement is the more realistic option.

services.whyAdvanced: Our team has hands-on experience with carpet repairs across the region. We bring the tools for patching and stretching, and give an honest assessment of whether repair or replacement makes more sense.

services.resultsHeading: How visible will a carpet repair be?
services.resultsCopy: A professional repair can make local damage virtually undetectable when the carpet matches well. We check the available colour, pile and wear before patching, and use power stretching to flatten ripples without replacing the carpet.

media.workAlt: Carpeted room at a residential property

services.enquiryCopy: Send a clear photo of the damage, its approximate size, the property address and whether you have spare matching carpet. We can then see whether an on-site assessment is needed.

faqs.question: What types of carpet damage can you repair?
faqs.answer: We assess burns, tears, pet damage, loose carpet, failing seams, transitions and areas that may suit a patch repair.

faqs.question: Do I need matching spare carpet?
faqs.answer: Yes, matching carpet needs to be available on site for a patch. An offcut or material from an inconspicuous area may be suitable.

faqs.question: Will the repair be invisible?
faqs.answer: Not always. Colour, wear, pile and material differences can make a repaired area visible.

faqs.question: Is repair better than replacement?
faqs.answer: It depends on the damage and the available matching carpet. We will assess the area and explain whether repair is realistic.

sections.heading: When should panels be cleaned?
paragraphs: We recommend cleaning twice a year: at the end of autumn to maximise power input over the lower-sun winter months, and at the end of spring to remove pollen and dust.
Dirty panels can cause you to lose up to 30% efficiency, depending on the situation. Regular cleaning helps keep the panels clear and working at their best.

faqs.question: Why clean solar panels?
faqs.answer: Dust, pollen, bird droppings and grime block light from reaching the panels and reduce output. Cleaning removes that build-up.

faqs.question: How often should panels be cleaned?
faqs.answer: We recommend twice a year: at the end of autumn before the lower-sun winter months, and at the end of spring to remove pollen and dust.

faqs.question: Will cleaning improve solar output?
faqs.answer: Removing build-up helps panels receive more light and maintain their performance. Dirty panels can lose up to 30% efficiency, depending on the situation.

faqs.question: Can you clean every roof and system?
faqs.answer: We can access many systems, but roof pitch, height, weather and safe access need to be checked first. Send us the details and photos so we can advise.
